note: Alberta Parks recreation area ~45 km east of Grande Prairie, 10 km south of Hwy 43 on Hwy 734: two small loops in the spruce on the east side of the Simonette River, with a trail down to the river. Self-registration (cash/cheque). Easy river access for fishing (grayling/whitefish/pike) and floating. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 11, 2026): 23 unserviced FCFS sites C$25; season May 14 - Sep 28 equals the stored manual season (not rewritten); 2026 drinking-water advisory moved into facilities.note. Riverview -> not waterfront recommended. Phone found.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview -> not waterfront RECOMMENDED. Tear sheet (Feb 2021): loop 1-14 east of the river with a trail to it, loop 15-23 to the south-west. Imagery: the north loop (~55.1369,-118.1858) is ~160-200 m from the river's gravel bar through forest; the south loop's pads (~55.1350,-118.1877) sit in spruce 60-90 m from a side channel across a tree belt and willow flats, the main channel ~170 m+ beyond a wide gravel bar. The page's only photo is taken on the river, not from a site. No evidence of a view from any pad, so down to not waterfront.
